description: Source code for the AudioDataS16Converter class, which converts audio buffers to 16-bit signed integer format, handling multichannel support and channel mixing.

classes.name: AudioDataS16Converter
classes.description: A class that converts audio buffers to signed 16-bit interleaved format, supporting multichannel mixing.

methods.name: ConvertToAudioDataS16
methods.description: Converts an AudioBuffer to mojom::AudioDataS16 format, handling multichannel support.

methods.name: ConvertToAudioDataS16
methods.description: Converts an AudioBus to mojom::AudioDataS16 format, with optional multichannel mixing.

methods.name: CopyBufferToTempAudioBus
methods.description: Copies data from an AudioBuffer to a temporary AudioBus for processing.

methods.name: ResetChannelMixerIfNeeded
methods.description: Resets or creates the channel mixer and monaural AudioBus if needed based on frame count and channel layout.
